achievements.description: You've successfully caught a fish, but it isn't quite what you expected!
achievements.hint: You do not need bait to catch normal fish, just a fishing rod.

When using a bait to get a specific fish, there's a chance you'll get a Rare Catch, which is essentially an alternate version of the fish you're using the bait for. You absolutely do need bait for this achievement.

At the beginning of Hydroplant, head towards the path where the "Docks" sign is, keep going straight until you hit the furthest wall. Look right and find a small place you can crouch to get to a room with a hole full of water. Enter said hole and keep going straight while looking up. Take the first exit you can find, follow the vent and there you'll find the body with the suit that'll give you the achievement.
Kill the Priest preaching in the church of Canaan.
Finish Royal Range. Royal Range is located in one of the doors very late into Cascade Laboratories in the containment zones and requires a Keypad Hacker (Tier 5) to get inside the room.

Contain the Leyak inside a Containment Unit: 91. This can be done by crafting, placing and powering up a Containment Unit, baiting close to the Containment Unit and then using an X-Ray Lamp or an X-Ray Tower to make the Leyak disappear.

NOT Missable but highly recommended to start and finish ASAP and before the ending due to the rewards.
This achievement has two parts and multiple steps that start as early as Reactors and finish as early as the end of the game. I recommend checking the guides section for a full guide on how to get this.

items.name: Obtain Kylie
items.desc: Bring a Diving Suit to where you get the "Go With The Flow" achievement (the one that gives you the blue suit). Jump down the hole and sink towards the direction where the interactable body was. Once you reach the crane at the end of the little platform, go to the opposite direction under the platform and follow the linear path. Speak to Kylie and get the recipe for a "Hyper-Dense Neural Chip". Craft the item and bring it to Kylie. Insert it where it asks you to and then grab Kylie (Trinket). Feel free to equip them (or not).

items.name: Fulfill Kylie's Promise
items.desc: Bring Kylie with you to the Botanical Gardens then enter the Red Portal in front of the Double Helix (DNA molecule) statue/structure/stairs. Once inside, move towards the beginning of the ascent and you'll find a hole in the wall with a little catwalk. Get inside that catwalk and follow the linear path to enter the Green Portal. Inside the Green Portal, go up the stairs and interact with the yellow part next to the console. When Kylie mentions she needs some time, proceed to the ending of the game. You won't get the achievement until after you get to the last portal world where the ending happens.
